newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Cresud seeks to offer 54 mln shrs in ADS.
newsitem.headline: Cresud seeks to offer 54 mln shrs in ADS.

text.p: Cresud SACIF y A has submitted a proposal for a global initial public equity offering of up to 54 million ordinary shares, a company statement said Monday.
The statement said the Argentinian agriculture property company filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
It said the company would offer the shares in the form of American Depository Shares, one of which would represent 10 shares.
"Application has been made to quote the ADS's on the Nasdaq Stock Market, Inc.," it said.
The statement said Cresud had also offered to make an offering in Argentina.
Merrill Lynch & Co would be the global coordinator, while Merrill Lynch and Banco Roberts would coordinate the offering in Argentina.
The company planned to make the offering March 18.
